ABOUT

About Me

I'm Prasanna Kummari, a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student who enjoys moving across the full stack — frontend, backend, and database — and increasingly toward applied AI. Two internships gave me real exposure to full-stack workflows and to Google Cloud's Generative AI stack, including the Gemini API and Vertex AI.

Outside coursework, I build independent projects that mix web development with AI: an Excel automation platform, an AI-assisted financial recovery tool, and a services marketplace, among others. I'm currently looking for an Associate Software Engineer role where I can keep building things like that, with a team.
